newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds set for upside test towards 103.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds set for upside test towards 103.00.

text.p: LIFFE September Bund futures will look to the upside and target moves towards 103.00, technical analysts said on Thursday.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst near Cambridge, said Bunds had made a sharp move up from key reaction lows leaving initial support at 102.40 and immediately below there.

"There is no really clear resistance until we actually get to 103.00," she said. "That will be difficult, I doubt if it will be cleared until next week but then it should be challenged quite strongly."
At 0704 GMT, September Bunds were at 102.66, up 0.23.
